mandatory_invariants: Preserve the module interfaces and parameter behavior required by the supplied design manifest.
Preserve exact cycle-by-cycle functionality and latency unless the request explicitly permits a latency change.
Preserve register and state boundaries unless the request explicitly permits retiming/state changes.
Do not introduce new clocks, clock domains, latches, or sequential state unless explicitly permitted by policy.
Modify only files and modules that belong to the exact supplied SourceBundle snapshot; diagnostic focus ranges are recommendations, not edit restrictions.
Use the supplied original SHA-256 for each complete source file you return.
Keep widths and signedness functionally equivalent.
For guided mode, recommended patterns are suggestions. For exploratory mode, no named pattern is required. Formal equivalence and physical evaluation are authoritative.
trust_boundary: Model self-checks and diagnostic focus adherence are advisory and are never used as functional-correctness gates. nEBULA independently enforces exact SourceBundle identity and per-file hashes, module ownership, structural/state-boundary policy, formal functional equivalence, and same-recipe physical PPA comparison.
